verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents an official CLI, the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit CLI. It is scoped to the developer lifecycle of Teams apps and agents: scaffolding from templates, provisioning and deploying to Azure, previewing in Teams, and validating, packaging and publishing. Nothing shows it can operate Teams itself, such as sending messages or managing teams and channels, which is done through the Graph API instead. Missing for 10: CLI commands for everyday Teams operations (messaging, channel/team management, chat export), agent-friendly output/automation documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
